key_findings.finding: The clearly relevant primary experimental paper is Hernandez-Bule et al., “Electric stimulation at 448 kHz promotes proliferation of human mesenchymal stem cells” (2014; PMID 25427571). The abstract specifies healthy-donor human adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs), exposed in vitro to repeated 448-kHz stimulation at a subthermal 50 μA/mm² (5 min on/4 h off); assays included XTT, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and Western blot.
